main.description: A generated chapter: narrative prose plus its rendered cloned-voice audio. Derived from campaign premise + character state at generation time.

campaign.description: The campaign this chapter belongs to.

transcript.description: The written narrative the audio was rendered from.

audio.description: Rendered chapter audio in the players' cloned voices. Up to 500 MB.

storyDate.description: In-world date the chapter takes place on (plain string).

status.description: Pipeline state. The DM sees 'processing' while this is writing|rendering.
